description:
Crimson Desert is finally here. The game is absolutely massive, and most importantly, chock full of things that it doesn’t tell you. While some of those things are there to discover for yourself, there are a ton of crucial details that are not explained to the player that are vital to understanding how to navigate, explore, and fight in the game’s world. To that end, here are 25 things we wish we knew before playing Crimson Desert.

description:
One of the biggest points of frustration in Crimson Desert is inventory management, as you’ll constantly find yourself filling up Kliff’s pockets with no room for additional items. In this quick guide, we’re going to walk you through how inventory works, some of the best practices for keeping it in check, and which items you’re always going to want to have on you so you can stop worrying about your stash and get back to enjoying the game.
